history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young man stands outdoors at night, posing in a street-style outfit. He is wearing a light grey hooded sweatshirt with a zipper, layered under a black puffer vest. His jeans are light wash denim with a distressed, splattered paint effect and a distinctive white belt featuring a prominent "LV" logo buckle. A white tag with "PURPLE" printed vertically hangs from the belt loop. He has on white and black sneakers with a sleek, modern design. The background consists of a paved stone walkway and a modern building with horizontal window blinds, dimly lit by artificial light, creating a moody, urban atmosphere. The lighting is low-key, with harsh shadows and highlights that emphasize the textures of his clothing and the surroundings. The overall color palette is dominated by cool tones of grey, black, and white, with subtle hints of blue in the jeans. The mood is confident and fashionable, typical of urban streetwear photography.
